title: Adaptive low-degree Boolean numerical representation from physically reachable consequences

parent.prior_result: WSP61 frozen negative: 210/384 active goals vs random 91/384, zero incorrect confident, original action-history exact observation lookup 380/384; old three-parent learner failed triple-XOR family; focused+G29 PASS; mandatory inherited full CI pending.

question: Can one source-blind causal learner promote its numerical representation from degree-one to degree-two interaction terms based on inconsistency evidence and predict never-observed physical transitions and longer-goal plans, rather than merely storing the training action ledger?

source.path: research/contrib/chatgpt/WSP-62/source.py evaluator-only; learner must not import
source.worlds: Four binary sensor registers, four shuffled role/action channels. Four seeds of conditional-chain dynamics; four parity-XOR sources; four mixed parity-with-conjunction conditional sources. True next-bit functions use Boolean algebraic-normal-form polynomial degree <=2, a source-family aligned hypothesis-class prior. Distinct from WSP61 by mixed interaction worlds.
source.physical_budget: Each policy executes exactly 80 sequential charged actions from single all-zero start; no arbitrary-state action consequence queries or free training reset.
source.task_budget: 32 evaluator-only source-reachable shortest 2-6-action goals per world; all 384 tasks evaluated identically against source from heldout start states. Raw sensor-vector targets; no language claim.
source.cold_transfer: Snapshot after 80 sequential actions, restore with no extra observations, verify predictions and all 32 plans identical. Tampered snapshot must fail.
source.generator_receipts: Independent hidden source and heldout-task SHA256, seed, family, action ledger SHA256, candidate source SHA.
source.no_exposure: Learner cannot import source module or use oracle rule/channel/role maps. Source evaluator may audit predictions after training only.

design.controlled_policy: Use the frozen WSP61 active action selector to produce exactly the SAME 80 chronological charged experiences for WSP61 fixed-three-parent learner and WSP62 expandable learner. This isolates representation from exploration. A second equal-action seeded-random trajectory feeds an identical WSP62 learner; no model-driven action selection modifications are allowed.
design.learned_representation: Numerical Boolean Algebraic Normal Form (ANF) coefficients over four observed binary sensors; start with degree<=1, expand to degree<=2 for a next-bit/action whenever observed contradictions disprove every degree<=1 fit. The degree<=2 model is source-family-aligned and supports parity and binary interactions; the learner may never access the true source family.
design.safety: Prediction only when all degree<=2 coefficient solutions consistent with the charged evidence agree on the requested outcome (GF(2) row-span test). If underdetermined, abstain. If evidence inconsistent with degree<=2, abstain rather than return wrong/confident. Lower-degree model is a diagnostic/expansion state and is NOT used to bypass the conservative degree<=2 uncertainty guard.
design.inference: Exact GF(2) row reduction to infer a constrained system of up to 11 boolean coefficients for each output bit/action; zero gradient steps. Prediction follows if the query feature vector belongs to the observed row-space, independent of hidden truth.
design.change_receipts: Record per-action/bit degree-one inconsistency witnesses and degree-two expansion events, number of resolved coefficient dimensions, numerical nonzero weights and memory bits.
design.comparisons: Same charged active ledger fixed WSP61 three-parent baseline and exact state-action lookup, all evaluated on the same heldout goals. Independent active vs seeded-random equal 80-action WSP62 trajectory shows exploration impact, not isolated representation causality. Fixed degree-one ANF diagnostic ablation.
design.compute: Report end-to-end test wall/CPU time, inference rows/compiled systems, active policy time, persistent bytes including raw evidence; equal actions do not imply equal computation.

prereg_primary: Exploratory SELFTEST_SIGNAL only if (A) adaptive learner solves >=300/384 heldout goals, (B) improves by >=50 solved goals over the frozen WSP61 fixed-three-parent learner using the EXACT SAME active 80-action ledger, (C) predicts >=25 TRUE source transitions at state-action combinations NOT present in the active training ledger (exact lookup necessarily abstains there), (D) active has ZERO incorrect confident source transitions over 12x64 audit, (E) >=4 observable degree-one inconsistency expansion events across mixed-interaction worlds, (F) all 12 have 80 continuous charged observations and snapshot parity. Otherwise retain SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE, no retuning.
secondary: Separate performance by chain, XOR and interaction families; fixed-degree1 and lookup controls; random-policy identical solver
Full 768 transition audit correct/wrong/abstain with unseen-condition counts
Source/task/action SHA256 custody, degree expansions, rank, weight counts, stored bits, wall/CPU
No causal grammar/language control in WSP62; isolated physics-learning measurement
limitations: Degree-2 Boolean ANF basis is chosen *before* experiments and aligns with all generated source laws, so this is not discovering an unrestricted representation language.

Sensor count/bit domains, action channels and fixed 6-step goal horizon are known; only source role relationships are hidden. All 12 sources belong to a designed synthetic family, not independent natural worlds.
ANF is an explicit numerical feature basis, not general-purpose neural network weight programming or language learning.
Evaluator chooses reachable task starts after training; no claim of autonomous free-world task selection.
No fully trained conventional neural and independent symbolic matched total-compute baseline, so SCIENTIFIC_PASS cannot be claimed even if development criterion passes.
stop_rules: Freeze prereg before source/learner/tests/outcomes and do not alter scientific thresholds/seeds/families after observing results.
If source/test harness mechanics fail before complete result, repair only mechanics without changing frozen scientific semantics; requalify exact source.
Never edit WSP61 recorded source, negative result, prereg or PR; new branch and draft PR only.
Mandatory final focused Linux+Windows, G29 source atlas and full inherited regression at exact final SHA before engineering acceptance.
